summary: No prior implementation of the merge-basis fix exists; the LEAD scope-lock amendment is the source of truth for the design. Found reusable throwaway-worktree test patterns and confirmed the sibling out-of-scope literal-path bug at .husky/pre-commit:718-720.
detailed_analysis: 1) No existing MERGE_HEAD-aware dual-diff intersection code in this repo; lib/ship/auto-merge.mjs:499 only reuses the string 'MERGE_HEAD' as an unrelated log label (MERGE_HEAD_MISMATCH). The just-recorded scope-lock amendment (scripts/one-off/lead-amend-precommit-secret-001.mjs) fully specifies the intended design: git rev-parse -q --verify MERGE_HEAD (never a literal .git/MERGE_HEAD path test, inert in worktrees); filter ^+/^+++ on both diffs first, then intersect via grep -Fxf (not comm -12, which fail-opens on unsorted input under this hook's 2>/dev/null || true style); mandatory fallback to the HEAD-only basis on any empty/errored MERGE_HEAD-derived set; FIXTURE_CONTENT (~:280) needs identical treatment to STAGED_CONTENT (~:274). 2) Sibling husky tests tests/unit/husky/pre-commit-nonempty-index-guard.test.js and pre-commit-marker-count.test.js both use vitest + spawnSync('bash',['-c',script]), gate via bashAvailable() -> describe.skip, build a throwaway repo via fs.mkdtempSync(os.tmpdir())+git init -q+commit, and assert against the real .husky/pre-commit content via fs.readFileSync. Neither currently uses git worktree add. 3) Reusable throwaway-worktree pattern exists at tests/unit/resolve-sd-workdir/worktree-atomicity.test.js:5,22,38 (os.tmpdir + git init for fixture repos, then execSync('git worktree add "<path>" -b <branch>', {cwd: repo})) and lib/worktree-quota.test.js:6-33 (same recipe) -- both are copyable templates for the worktree-shaped T1 test case. 4) Confirmed the sibling out-of-scope literal-path bug at .husky/pre-commit:718-720 ([ -f ".git/COMMIT_EDITMSG" ]; COMMIT_MSG=$(cat .git/COMMIT_EDITMSG ...)) -- same defect class, correctly named out-of-scope in this SD's locked scope.
recommendations: Reuse the git worktree add fixture pattern from tests/unit/resolve-sd-workdir/worktree-atomicity.test.js / lib/worktree-quota.test.js for the T1 worktree-shaped regression test case
Follow the existing tests/unit/husky/*.test.js harness convention (vitest + spawnSync bash + bashAvailable() skip-guard + mkdtempSync) for the new regression test file
